faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about BusJaén.
faq.q1: How do I buy a ticket?
faq.a1: Search for your journey on the home page by entering origin, destination and date, choose a departure, pick a seat and confirm. Then complete the simulated payment and you will get your ticket with a QR code.
faq.q2: Do I need an account to book?
faq.a2: You can browse lines, schedules and seat availability without signing up, but you must log in to confirm a booking and pay.
faq.q3: How do I get my ticket?
faq.a3: After paying, the ticket with its QR code appears in the booking detail and we also send you a copy by email.
faq.a4: Yes. From "My bookings" you can open any booking and cancel it. As this is an academic prototype, no real charges or refunds apply.
faq.a5: No. The payment is simulated for academic purposes: you can use the pre-filled test card. No real charges are processed and the full card number is never stored.
faq.q6: Where does the schedule and stop data come from?
faq.a6: Line, stop and timetable data come from the open data of the Jaén Area Metropolitan Transport Consortium (CTAN).
